title: Binary Search in 15 seconds
description: Day 15: halve the range every step.

scenes.heading: Looking for 23 in a sorted list
scenes.narration: Here is a sorted list of sixteen numbers. Where is twenty three?

scenes.heading: Cut the range in half
scenes.narration: Start with the whole sorted list and check the middle, which is fifteen. Fifteen is smaller than twenty three, so we throw away the left half. Now check the new middle, which is twenty three. Found it in two checks, not sixteen.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.narration: Each step halves the search space. Subscribe for Day 16.
